newsitem.title: USA: American Power rescinds buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: American Power rescinds buyback plan.

text.p: American Power Conversion Corp said Thursday its board had voted to rescind the company's stock repurchase program.
The program, announced in April, had authorized the buyback of up to $15 million of APC stock, or about one percent of the outstanding shares.
The program was about about 10 percent complete.

The decision to rescind results from uncertainties about a Securities and Exchange Commission rule that may limit the flexibility of companies with ongoing stock repurchase programs to employ the pooling-of-interest accounting method when making acquisitions, American Power said.

"We believe that continuing the program could restrict our ability to pursue the full range of strategic business development opportunities in which the company may engage to further enhance our market position," said Rodger Dowdell, president and chief executive.
